- D2 vs variances_only: -0.5762 (-0.6701 to -0.4442); closed form better in 8/8
- D2 vs regression: -0.0572 (-0.0817 to -0.0308); closed form better in 8/8

Pairing-free negative control (primary estimator): observed mean error 0.536, derangement mean 1.255; p = 1/201 for each of 12 donors.

Learning curve (mean error): 5 biopsies 0.723, 10 biopsies 0.610, 15 biopsies 0.553

D2 was not run for the pairing-free arms. All analyses are retrospective; see PLAN.md.

The pairing-free rows above are the first version. A corrected re-analysis (../cross_study/colon_pf_rigor.py: disjoint cell halves, donor-grouped folds, extended grids, converged fits, donor-aware permutations) gives mean error pf_means 0.566, pf_moment 0.680; Figure 3b of the revision shows the corrected values.
